Subject: Weekly MAP pulse — two overdue asks & quick mitigation plan

Thanks for the updates. Two quick nudges and a proposed mitigation plan:

1) Lydia — procurement confirmation for internal budget (milestone: Procurement kickoff). Can you provide the approver name and expected decision date? If procurement needs more time, we can offer a limited pilot SOW that reduces procurement scope (engineering sandbox + read-only PHI scope) so you can start technical integration before full vendor sign-off.

2) Legal clause — if Lydia can drop the data residency language (even as a draft) into the MAP spreadsheet I can get our legal to mirror it and speed turnaround.

Mitigation: Redwood will prioritize a canary slot in early January if procurement confirms by 12/10; if not, we will scope a narrow pilot that requires a reduced legal review and no cross-region data sync. That keeps momentum without blocking your internal cycles.

Ask: please mark each milestone in v0.4 as "on track" / "at risk" / "blocked" in the acceptance column by EOD Thursday 12/02 so we can finalize the rollout plan.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-example-MAP (MAP folder), HubSpot:HS-45823 (deal), DocuSign packet link (if/when SOW starts).

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
